changes: Reworked how combat rewards are calculated behind the scenes so your EXP bar and level no longer occasionally jump up and then revert a few seconds later — gold, EXP, and Achievements kill counts are now calculated the same consistent way locally and on the server instead of two separate random simulations that could disagree
Achievements kill counts now track fractional progress under the hood so fast-paced fighting no longer loses tiny amounts of progress to rounding
Fixed Achievements kill counts occasionally losing kills when combat resolved twice in quick succession
Toned down Dodge — it was letting Agility-heavy characters (Hunters especially) avoid half of every incoming hit from as early as level 45, regardless of gear
Added a "Miss" floating combat text whenever an attack is dodged or misses, in either direction
Narrowed the gap between an item's minimum and maximum damage roll — hits are now much more consistent instead of swinging as wildly between a weak and a strong hit

Gear composition (+N) now actually boosts your stats — Weapons/Rings get Physical/Magic Attack, Necklaces/Hats/Coats get Defense, Boots get Dodge, each scaling with the item's own level. Shows as a purple "Bonus" line on the item's tooltip
Players Online no longer counts accounts that have minimised or backgrounded the game — only tabs you're actually looking at count as online

Fixed sold Marketplace listings showing "Item unavailable" in your listing history — it now shows exactly what you sold, even after the item changes hands (not retroactive for listings sold before this update)
The global announcement banner now has a "See more" option (when manually reopened) showing the last 10 rare events across everyone — armor socket procs and Lucky Lad wins alike

Added a real Sockets tab to the Forge — drag gear with sockets in, then drag gems from your Inventory onto its socket slots to fill them (a filled socket can be overwritten with a different gem, but never emptied)
Fixed the "gained a socket" announcement sometimes naming the item's previous tier instead of its new one, when a Level Upgrade and a socket both landed on the same attempt
The AFK/unclaimed rewards popup shows every item again (Normal and quality alike) instead of hiding Normal gear behind a single "Sell All Normal" button with nothing visible

Massively increased how often gear drops come out Tempered, Infused, Radiant, or Ascended instead of Normal — quality gear was landing at roughly 1-in-a-million-plus odds and is now tuned toward a handful of Tempered pieces, a couple Infused, and the occasional Radiant/Ascended over a typical AFK session
Global announcements now cover more Lucky Lad wins — Fallen Star, Tempered/Ascended Gems, and the 3 hyper-rare gear rewards all get announced now, not just the two Scroll types
Lucky Lad cards are now square with bigger chest art, and a revealed card shows its item centered above the opened chest
Lucky Lad's revealed reward tiles are now real Inventory-style tiles — hover for the full tooltip, same size and background effect as everywhere else
Fixed the update banner's Refresh button doing nothing for some players (mostly on Firefox) — it now forces a clean reload if the normal update path doesn't kick in within a couple seconds
Lucky Lad polish: Money Bag rewards are much rarer now, gold values have been raised to compensate, and the reveal is a small floating burst instead of a full popup
Composition Stone icons no longer crowd their Inventory tile
Lucky Lad rewards overhauled: gold now comes wrapped in Class 1-10 Money Bags (Open them from your Inventory for a burst of gold, with a bigger reveal for the rarer classes)
Lucky Lad can now also award Composition Stones, Gems (including a Random Gem Bag), and — very rarely — a Radiant 2-socket Bow or Coat, or a piece of Ascended gear
Gems now have their own Inventory tile and can be Banked (and withdrawn) from the Bank tab, the same way Comets and Fallen Stars work
Comet Scrolls and Fallen Star Scrolls can now be Banked directly (or Banked All) from the Bank tab, at their full 10-unit value, without unbundling them into loose Comets/Fallen Stars first
No visible change (version bump to test the update banner's periodic check)
Fixed the update banner never appearing in an already-open tab — it now checks for a new version every minute instead of only once at page load
No visible change (version bump to test the new update banner)
Added an "update available" banner with a Refresh button — new versions used to apply silently on your next reload, now you'll be prompted right away
Iris Gem now has real icon art for all 3 tiers, completing art for all 4 currently-designed Gems (still not obtainable in-game)
Ember Gem now has real icon art for all 3 tiers (still not obtainable in-game)
Bastion Gem now has real icon art for all 3 tiers (still not obtainable in-game)
Fixed a leftover checkerboard artifact on the Tempered and Ascended Drake Gem icons
Drake Gem now has real icon art for all 3 tiers (still not obtainable in-game)
Added a live "Players Online" counter
Added a global announcement banner that flashes up whenever anyone gets a rare gear socket or wins a Comet/Fallen Star Scroll from Lucky Lad
Laid the groundwork for a Gem socketing system (Drake, Ember, Bastion, and Iris Gems) — not yet obtainable in-game
Fixed the Forge wrongly refusing to unbundle Scrolls for an upgrade cost even when doing so would actually free up Inventory space, not use more
Fixed Master Forge (and the regular Forge/Socket unlock) not recognizing Comet/Fallen Star Scrolls when checking if you could afford an upgrade
Fixed your Scroll count not updating right away after an upgrade automatically used one
Fighting monsters well above your level now hits noticeably harder — your Defense counts for a lot less in those fights
Added a clear on-screen warning while you're knocked out and waiting to revive
Achievements that used to reward a Fallen Star now reward a Comet Scroll instead
Comet Scroll and Fallen Star Scroll now have an "Open" option right in their tooltip instead of a separate card
Simplified the Account Bank: Comets/Fallen Stars now just Bundle/Bank/Bank All, and Composition/Gear points use a cleaner tier-picker instead of a wall of squares
Composition Stones now go up to Tier 9 (was capped at Tier 4), with real icon art for every tier
Comet Scroll and Fallen Star Scroll now show real icon art everywhere they appear (Inventory, Bank, Marketplace, Lucky) instead of a plain scroll emoji
Fixed a bug where Account Achievement zone bonuses didn't count tiers you'd already claimed before this system existed — they're now correctly recalculated from your full claim history
Account Achievements' zones now show their earned Attack/Quality bonus directly on the zone card, so you don't need to expand it to see — replaces the old separate summary list
Account Achievements' Attack Bonus is now per-zone (only active while fighting in the zone it was earned in), matching how the Quality Bonus already works — it was accidentally applying everywhere
Rebalanced Account Achievement rewards: Attack Bonus is now a flat 1% per tier per monster in every zone, and Quality Bonus starts at 1% per tier and increases slightly zone by zone
Shrank and centered the Shop's 2x2 tab buttons on desktop — they were far too large
Salvage now costs the same Ascension Points as selling (Tempered 1, Infused 2, Radiant 3, Ascended 4)
Rebuilt Salvage as a drag-and-drop slot with a 1.5 second salvaging animation, replacing the old checkbox multi-select
Dragging an item now highlights the box it can be dropped into once you're close enough

Bank withdrawals of Comets/Fallen Stars now clearly show they land as Scrolls in your Character Inventory (not the Account Storage grid), and switching to the Account view no longer hides a withdrawal that just happened

Account Achievements now grant a per-zone bonus to the chance a dropped item is higher quality (instead of boosting how often items drop at all) — later zones grant a bigger bonus per claim than earlier ones

Bank tab renamed to 'Account Bank', and tapping a Bank square now opens a proper pop-up with a slider for depositing/withdrawing — withdrawing a lot of Comets or Fallen Stars now bundles them into Scrolls automatically to save inventory space
Added a Salvage tab to the Forge — trade in unwanted gear for Ascension Points
Gaining Bank currency, Salvage AP, or Shop gold now shows a small floating '+amount' notification
The Lucky Bow can now be Level Upgraded into the Sapling Bow, continuing up the Bow chain
Removed the Wooden Sword from the Hunter's Shop (Hunters already start with the Lucky Bow)
Redesigned the Shop into four square buttons — Weapons, Armor, Jeweller (new — Rings and Necklaces), and Potions
Restyled scrollbars to be slimmer and match the game's theme
Fixed a bug where buying or reclaiming a Marketplace listing didn't show up in Mail until you refreshed the page
Added a real icon for the Hunter's Quiver (previously just an emoji)
The Quiver's glow effect on the Equipment screen now matches your equipped Bow's quality tier — a cosmetic-only touch, doesn't change the Quiver itself
Added real icons for Nimble, Charmed, Liberty, and Frostbite Boots, completing the full Boots catalog
Added real icons for Scalehide, Viperskin, Prowler, Spotted, and Direbeast Boots
Added real icons for Rawhide, Fawnskin, Padded, Hawkstep, and Featherstep Boots
Added real icons for Facet, Wyrmscale, Weeping, Oathbound, and Stormcaller Ring, completing the full Ring catalog
Added real icons for Bonewhite, Verdant, Opal, Banded, and Glass Ring
Corrected the Ring icon lineup again: Pewter Ring has its real icon back, Violet Ring has its real icon, and the incorrect Bonewhite/Verdant Ring icons from the previous fix were removed
Fixed a Ring icon mix-up: Gilded Ring now has its correct gold/sapphire art, and Bonewhite and Verdant Ring picked up the icons that had been misassigned to Gilded and Violet
Pewter Ring's icon was removed for now until real art arrives for it
Added real icons for Tin, Brass, Pewter, Gilded, and Violet Ring
Added real icons for Umbral, Reverie, and Cyclone Necklace, completing the full Necklace catalog
Added real icons for Sunmetal, Whitesteel, Obsidian, Serpent's, and Reliquary Necklace
Reordered the early Necklace lineup: Twine Necklace is now the first (level 7), followed by Wisp (17) and Locket (27)
Added real icons for Twine, Wisp, Locket, Emerald, and Quartz Necklace
Added real icons for all 11 Archer Coats (Fawnhide, Vixen, Timberwolf, Dappled, Silverback, Quilted, Finscale, Hidebound, Skyfeather, Wyrmhide, and Emberplate Coat)
Added real icons for all 11 Archer Hats (Mole, Lynx, Coyote, Ocelot, Simian, Ferret, Stag, Bullhide, Talon, Finhead, and Cinderplume Hat)

Redesigned Loot Holding: sell your Normal-tier junk first, then handle any Comets/Fallen Stars found, and finally decide what to do with any higher-quality gear one at a time (Claim, Store to your account-wide Bank, or Sell)
Added "Store" for gear in Loot Holding — sends an item straight to your account-wide Bank Storage, bypassing a full Inventory entirely, so nothing can get stuck anymore
Claim/Store buttons now turn red when their destination is full, instead of just failing silently
Fixed withdrawing more Comets/Fallen Stars from the Bank than your Inventory had room for — withdrawals are now capped at how much space you actually have

Forge upgrades, Master Forge, and weapon socket unlocks now automatically unbundle a Comet/Fallen Star Scroll if you're short on loose ones and it can afford the cost, refusing the whole action if there's no Inventory room for the leftover change
Comets, Fallen Stars, and Composition Stones in the Bank now show as icons with their quantity underneath, instead of plain text
Fixed idle rewards granting an unexpectedly huge time window from claiming an easy, free Achievement tier — the bonus now scales with the much harder account-wide Achievements ladder instead
Fixed a Loot Holding item being unclaimable with no way forward when your Inventory was full — added a "Clear Everything" option that sells/banks everything left, no matter the quality tier
Fixed Lottery Ticket rewards showing as "+1 Lottery Ticket" — it now just reads "Lottery Ticket" (or "Lottery Tickets" if you're ever awarded more than one at once)

Reworked Achievements: Prestige is gone — each Kill Count tier is now a real one-time Claim button (with a notification badge showing what's ready), escalating toward a free Infused-quality gear item at the top tier
The account-wide Achievements ladder (kills summed across all your characters) now grants real, permanent account-wide bonuses to attack and drop chance when claimed
Added the Lottery Ticket item — a rare Achievements reward that can be spent for a free LuckyLad draw
Achievements page has a full new look — tier progress, rewards, and claim buttons are all clearer at a glance
Quality and Level Upgrade success chance is no longer a flat rate — it now depends on the item's own level and quality, starting easy and getting meaningfully harder on better gear
Added Master Forge: pay a premium (1.5x the expected manual cost) for a guaranteed-success Quality or Level Upgrade, with a new equipped-item picker so you don't have to unequip first

Fixed opening a Comet/Fallen Star Scroll being wrongly rejected as "not enough room" for anyone with equipped or banked gear — the room check was counting those against your Inventory space when it shouldn't have
Fixed a dead end where a full Inventory made it impossible to claim pending Comets/Fallen Stars — you can now Bank them straight to your account instead, one at a time or all at once

Fixed the normal hover tooltip sometimes overlapping a tile's own popover (Equip/Compare, Bank Deposit, Bundle, Sell) — the peek now steps aside while that tile's popover is open, but still works normally everywhere else
Equipment screen: Necklace/Ring and Off-hand/Main Hand now sit staggered between Head/Armor/Boots instead of lined up with them, with a bit more vertical breathing room
The EXP readout now shows a plain percentage to your next level (e.g. 93.55%) instead of the old raw fraction
Predicted EXP now runs slightly under the real value on purpose, so when it syncs up with the server it only ever corrects upward, never back down
Ascension Points now show next to Gold in the top bar, with real icon art
Redesigned the Equipment screen's paper-doll layout — Head/Armor/Boots stacked in the center, Necklace and Off-hand/Shield/Quiver on the left, Ring and Main Hand weapon on the right

Fixed Comet/Fallen Star Scroll bundling (and gold/Comet/Fallen Star gains generally) sometimes reverting shortly after — a background sync could occasionally undo an action that happened right before it landed
Fixed the idle-rewards popup rarely (or never) appearing after minimizing the app on mobile/Home Screen PWA — no more needing to force-quit and relaunch to catch up
Fixed the EXP bar visibly dropping to 0 and reclimbing every few seconds during combat — a regression from the recent predictive-leveling change, gold was unaffected

Fixed the idle-rewards popup sometimes reappearing after you'd already dealt with it — it now stays open with a clear message if an item couldn't fit, instead of silently closing and coming back later
You can now sell any item (not just Normal-tier) straight from the idle-rewards popup by tapping it
Added a small unclaimed-loot button in the bottom-left corner as a fallback way to reach leftover rewards, so the popup no longer needs to reopen on its own
Leveling up now happens instantly when you get the killing blow, instead of waiting several seconds for confirmation — no more EXP bar sitting stuck at full
Background reward confirmation now runs about 4x more often, so real gold/EXP/loot catch up to what you see on screen much faster
Bundling Comets/Fallen Stars into Scrolls now opens as a small tooltip popover right at the tile instead of a separate card below the Inventory grid
Item icons now render larger inside their tile/box (less empty margin around gear, currency, and reward art everywhere it appears)
Monsters below your level now have noticeably weaker Defense, making farming easier ones feel meaningfully faster
Monsters well above your level now hit you noticeably harder — punching above your level is riskier, matching how tougher fights should feel
Later levels now take noticeably longer than earlier ones — retuned the promotion-tier difficulty jumps to escalate more steeply
Offline/AFK EXP now earns at half the rate of live play — actually playing is meaningfully faster than leaving the game running
Getting knocked out no longer instantly heals and stops the fight — you're locked out of attacking for 10 seconds, then revive and the fight picks up where it left off
Fixed leveling being far too slow — monster EXP reward now scales with the required-EXP curve instead of a flat rate that fell way behind at higher levels
Difficulty still escalates at each promotion tier (1/15/40/70/100/110/120), not a flat rate throughout — early levels stay quick, later levels take meaningfully longer
Added EXP for damage dealt, not just kills — every hit now earns a slice of EXP, worth 50% extra on top of a full kill
AFK/offline catch-up time now scales with your best Prestige tier on any monster — up to 20 hours credited instead of a flat 2, as a reward for investing in Prestige
Added a real icon for the Voidcaller Bow — every Bow in the game now has real art
Added real icons for the Wyrmstring, Timeworn, Skyborne, Sorcerous, and Emberwing Bows
Added real icons for the Heartwood, Runed, Starfall, Nightglow, and Rosemark Bows
Bumped the Sapling Bow and Ranger's Bow icons to 320×320, matching the rest of the set
Widened item tooltips so the text column keeps its old width now that the icon is bigger, instead of getting squeezed
Bumped all 13 recent bow icons from 160×160 to 320×320 — more vibrant/detailed now that they're not being downscaled as hard
Item tooltip icons are now shown twice as large
Removed the temporary icon-resolution comparison test from Settings
Added a real icon for the Stripeback Bow (the last of this batch)
Added a viewing-only "Icon Res Test" tab in Settings comparing the standard 160×160 icon size against a 320×320 double-resolution test version, side by side
Added real icons for the Farreach Bow, Drover's Bow, Forgesteel Bow, and Windwing Bow
Added a real icon for the Sovereign Bow
Added a real icon for the Ram's Horn Bow
Added real icons for the Gale Bow and Vermil Bow
Added a real icon for the Stonewood Bow
Added a real icon for the Evergreen Bow
Added a real icon for the Thornwood Bow
Re-processed the Lucky Bow icon — the previous one had a checkerboard pattern baked into it instead of a real transparent background
Added a real icon for the Lucky Bow
Fixed gear mouseover tooltips not showing in the Combat tab's Inventory grid
Fixed withdrawing an item from the Bank making it vanish instead of returning it to your Inventory
Bank tab tiles now show their normal tooltip on hover again, alongside the click-to-deposit/withdraw popover
Each zone in Achievements now shows a milestone progress bar with its Fallen Star rewards on hover, instead of a plain text line
Renamed DragonBall to Fallen Star and Meteor to Comet everywhere
Renamed the remaining internal Warehouse references to Bank
Renamed the quality tier names (Refined/Unique/Elite/Super became Tempered/Infused/Radiant/Ascended a while back — the underlying save data now matches those names too)
Pet drop rate is now 1 in 25,000 (down from 1 in 5,000 — it was too easy to get before)
Getting a pet during live play now shows a celebration pop-up
Returning from being away now calls out any pet you obtained, and separately highlights any DragonBall you found while away
Browse listings in the Marketplace now include your own — a "Your listing" badge shows instead of a Buy button for those
Fixed the LuckyLad chests stretching way too tall on desktop instead of staying a reasonable card size
Fixed the Bank tab's Storage grid sitting left-aligned instead of centered, so it no longer jumps sideways when switching between Inventory and Storage
Reworked the Bank tab — Storage and all Bank points are now shared account-wide across all your characters instead of separate per character
Bank tab now has two buttons to switch between your Inventory and Account Storage, with a grid of simple squares on the side showing your Bank totals
Every bankable item in Inventory now offers both Deposit (store the physical item) and Bank (convert it to currency/points) right on the tile, where applicable
Removed the old, unused Warehouse token system entirely
Redesigned the desktop navigation bar to match the mobile bottom nav's icon-forward look, including Combat's dynamic weapon icon and live Fighting/Idle indicator
Fixed a background permissions bug where potions weren't being counted toward your Inventory-full check during combat resolution
Fixed a bug where items claimed from Loot Holding always showed as level 1, even when they were actually a higher-level item (stats were always correct — only the displayed level was wrong)
Corrected the level on every already-claimed item this affected
Fixed a bug where depositing gear into Bank Storage destroyed its identity — banked gear now sits in Storage exactly like it does in Inventory (same quality/level/composition/sockets, no stacking)
Meteors, DragonBalls, and Composition Stones can now also be stored as physical Storage tiles, as a second option alongside the existing currency/points deposit
Deposit/Deposit All and Withdraw/Withdraw All are now buttons right on each item's own popover, not a separate header control
Bank tab: gear and stones in your Inventory now have a quick Deposit button (tap an item), plus a Deposit All shortcut
Bank tab: Storage now has a Withdraw All button (withdraws everything at the free Normal tier)
Reverted the Meteor/DragonBall drop chance change from last version — that wasn't the right fix
Instead, the Kill Count achievement's bonus drop-chance now scales with monster level, so maxing it out on an easy monster gives a much smaller boost than on a harder one
Meteor/DragonBall drop chance now scales with monster level — low-level monsters are worse for currency farming, high-level monsters are much better

Added the first real Kill Count gear rewards — reach 1000 kills on each Windhollow monster for a piece of Tempered gear (Quailwing: Armor, Mourning Dove: Weapon, Redbreast: Ring, Warshade: Necklace, Grim Specter: Boots)
Fixed a bug that could repeatedly re-grant zone Achievement DragonBall rewards instead of paying them out once
Added an Inventory card to the Equipment tab, below your Stats — no need to switch to Combat just to equip gear
"Lucky" is now "LuckyLad", with a real mascot icon
Lucky cards now show a closed treasure chest face-down, and an opened chest when revealed
"Unlocks" is now called "Prestige" — advancing it now also requires reaching Kill Count Tier 1 on that monster, not just paying Meteors/DragonBalls
Kill Count now boosts your Meteor/DragonBall drop chance instead of gold — Prestige is the one that boosts gold now
Added zone-wide Achievement tracking — each zone shows how many of its monsters' kill-count tiers you've completed in total, with its own DragonBall rewards at milestones
Fixed a long-press on an item icon popping up your phone's native Save/Share image menu instead of the in-game tooltip
Fixed tooltip icon placement — it now sits in its own column beside the full tooltip text instead of just next to the title
Item tooltips now show the item's icon alongside its name, everywhere tooltips appear
Added a real icon for the Ranger's Bow
Added the first real weapon icon — the Sapling Bow now shows its own art everywhere it appears (Inventory, Forge, Bank, Shop, Marketplace)
Fixed a database error that was blocking the new Lucky ticket-draw feature from working
Added the Lucky ticket-draw feature — a free ticket every 6 hours, or pay 20 Ascension Points for more, pick 1 of 9 cards for a reward
Rewards currently include gold, Meteors, DragonBalls, and Meteor/DragonBall Scrolls — more reward types are coming
Redesigned the mobile bottom navigation — Market, Bank, Shop, and Forge now live behind a new "Town" button that rolls them up instead of each taking their own slot
Added a new Lucky tab (placeholder for now) — a ticket-draw feature is coming soon
Tapping a gear item in your Inventory now opens Equip/Compare directly on the item instead of a separate details card
Compare shows the item you're about to equip side by side with whatever's currently in that slot

Achievement kill-count rewards and paid Unlock rewards are now separate — reaching a kill milestone grants its gold bonus for free, and unlocking a tier grants its own bonus immediately instead of waiting on your kill count
Redesigned the Welcome Back screen's Loot Holding list — fixed the item grid getting cut off on narrower screens
Simplified Loot Holding to just Sell All Normal plus a single Claim button, instead of selecting and claiming items one at a time
Meteors, DragonBalls, and their Scrolls can now be listed on the Marketplace, drag-and-drop, just like gear — always 1 unit per listing
Accounts are now capped at 20 active Marketplace listings total, across every character

Fixed dropping a dragged item just outside a drop zone's exact boundary — it now also counts if the floating icon itself visibly overlaps the zone, not just your actual finger/cursor position underneath it

Fixed the quality-tier ember glow not showing up on the Equipment tab's paper doll — it's a separate tile component from Inventory/Forge/Bank's and was missed when the effect first went live everywhere else
Ascension Points are now shared account-wide instead of separate per character, matching how a premium currency should work
Added the Marketplace — list a gear item for sale in Gold or the new Ascension Points, for a chosen time window, and other players can browse and buy it
Added Ascension Points, a new currency earned by selling Tempered, Infused, Radiant, or Ascended gear (Normal gear doesn't earn any)
Added Mail — bought items and unsold/cancelled listings are delivered here to claim into your Inventory
Listing an item costs a 5% fee up front, which is kept whether or not the item actually sells
Tempered/Infused/Radiant/Ascended gear now glows with a radiating ember effect wherever it's shown — Inventory, Forge, Equipment, Bank, and rewards — denser and brighter at higher quality

Fixed Achievement kill counts (both the character and account ladders) never being recorded, in either live or AFK play — a missing database permission was silently blocking every kill from being saved
Radiating-from-center is now the favorite Item Effects look — added radiating versions of Tempered (5 embers), Infused (10), and Radiant (25) alongside their original rising versions for comparison
Fixed equipped gear staying visible in the Inventory grid until clicking a different item — it now disappears from Inventory the instant it's equipped
Confirmed Ascended's vibrant-core-glow look as the real Item Effects example; Tempered now shows 4 embers, Ascended 15

Simplified item tooltips to just show the level, since the quality is already shown in the item's name

Normal quality now shows no Item Effects preview at all
Added two extra Ascended examples for comparison — a brighter "vibrant core" glow, and a variant where embers radiate outward from the center instead of rising

Item Effects now shows Rising Embers once per quality tier (Normal through Ascended), colored to match each tier and getting denser at higher tiers, replacing the earlier grab-bag of unrelated example effects

Added 3 new "premium" Item Effects examples — a foil-card light sweep, rising ember particles, and a soft pulsing glow with corner accents — as simpler alternatives to the web/lightning line-art examples

Fixed the Item Effects gallery's new Ember Cloud examples rendering almost solid black — the dark crack color and multiply blend mode both only work against a light background, not our near-black tiles
Added two new Item Effects examples matching the user's actual close-up reference screenshots — a mottled ember-cloud texture with a few thin dark cracks overlaid, instead of glowing neon lines

Fixed the Item Effects gallery's lightning examples all looking nearly identical — they shared one "every bolt through the center" shape; added a genuinely different scattered-node mesh web structure and rebuilt the layered/branching/pulsing examples on top of the two distinct shapes

Reworked the Item Effects gallery's web-style examples to use actual jagged, branching lightning bolts (proper fractal generation) instead of smooth noise or straight lines, and added a true layered-depth version and a branching version

Added an "Item Effects" tab in Settings — a gallery of 7 example animated background effects (web-like lightning, layered noise, crackling lines, energy sweeps, and more) to preview and compare, ahead of picking one for real gear tiles
Replaced the gradient badge/wordmark heading with a cleaner, larger version of the original uppercase-tracking style
Fixed the Meteor/DragonBall drag ghost showing an old placeholder icon instead of the real art while dragging

Fixed a hover tooltip that could occasionally get stuck on screen instead of closing
Fixed the Bank's Storage and Inventory grids overflowing on mobile screens
Renamed "Items" to "Inventory" wherever the Inventory grid is labeled

Redesigned the top header — removed the redundant "Idle Combat" text, gave the "Ascension Idle" title a nicer look, and the account buttons are now icon-only on mobile, sitting on the same row as the title
The Forge's Preview square now has a working hover tooltip showing the exact upgraded item — quality, level, sockets, and all — instead of just a name and color
Simplified the Confirm step to a plain Confirm/Cancel choice instead of repeating the item's name and level
Forge's Upgrade/Material/Preview squares now line up at the same height instead of the two-line label pushing one down
Doubled the spacing between the Upgrade/Material/Preview squares
Fixed uneven spacing between the Forge's Upgrade/Material/Preview squares so the row is properly centered — a wide label was silently pushing one square further from the others
Forge's Upgrade, Material, and Preview slots are now three equal-sized squares, centered on the page
The Material slot shows a 'Drop item here' hint just like the Upgrade slot

Drop a Meteor, DragonBall, or Composition Stone/gear straight into the Material slot to trigger Level Upgrade, Quality Upgrade, or Composition — no more picking a type from buttons first

Archer's starting attributes are now confirmed real numbers instead of a guess
